nodes.description: Public mapping (address => uint) tracking each hodler's deposited balance; written in the fallback and zeroed in party().
Constant uint (1749995999) timestamp gate used by party(); part of a block.timestamp dependency check.
Payable fallback function; adds msg.value to hodlers[msg.sender] and emits Hodl.
Withdrawal function; requires block.timestamp > partyTime and hodlers[msg.sender] > 0, zeroes the balance, then transfers value to msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address used as mapping key, transfer recipient and balance owner in both functions.
Miner-influenceable timestamp compared against partyTime inside party().
External ETH transfer to caller executed at the end of party(); the reentrancy-relevant interaction with an untrusted address.
Unchecked addition into the hodlers mapping in the payable fallback; arithmetic overflow candidate.
Require condition combining a block.timestamp gate with a caller-balance check; timestamp dependency and access gate.
Local uint in party() caching hodlers[msg.sender] before it is zeroed and transferred out.

edges.reason: The payable fallback executes the unchecked balance addition hodlers[msg.sender] += msg.value.
msg.sender is the caller-controlled mapping key used in the increment expression.
The increment operation writes the computed value back into the hodlers state variable.
msg.sender indexes the hodlers mapping to identify the depositor's balance slot.
The fallback function mutates the hodlers state variable.
party() enforces the require condition guarding on time and caller balance.
block.timestamp flows into the time gate comparison, making the withdrawal timestamp dependent.
The partyTime constant is compared against block.timestamp in the guard condition.
msg.sender selects hodlers[msg.sender] for the > 0 balance requirement.
party() declares and assigns the local variable value = hodlers[msg.sender].
The hodlers state variable is read into the local value.
msg.sender indexes hodlers to determine the value read into the local variable.
party() performs the external ETH transfer to the caller as its final statement.
The untrusted msg.sender is the recipient of the external transfer call.
The local value is the amount forwarded in the external transfer.
The hodlers balance is zeroed before the external transfer, linking state mutation and the untrusted call.

normalization_plan.reason: The local variable value is only a temporary cache of hodlers[msg.sender] supplied as the amount of the external transfer, so it should be merged into the transfer unsafe_operation.
